title: failure-capsules: offline incident capsules with a deterministic synthetic replay
description:
Standard-library Python research prototype that turns an incident into a compact, schema-validated JSON bug report (a failure capsule) without including original sensor measurements. A capsule records software and configuration versions, a timestamp policy, broad device/channel-group categories, an event class, categorical coarse features, a seeded synthetic replay recipe, expected and observed behavior, and a self-reported checklist. The validator is fail-closed: unknown fields, known raw-data key names, oversized integers, unbounded recipe values and number-list feature values are rejected, and unreadable input exits with a non-zero code instead of a traceback. The replay generator produces a baseline-plus-drift sequence that is deterministic for a given seed and recipe on CPython 3.x.

Evidence tags. Replay values, the example capsule and unit tests: SYNTHETIC. Use on real incident workflows: UNRUN (not claimed). No performance or privacy metrics are claimed.

Scope and limits. Research prototype. It is a format guard, not a privacy scanner, and it does not perform certified anonymization, de-identification, encryption or access control. It is not a certified safety system, a medical device or a commercial product. No production-readiness claim is made.

Evidence tags follow sparkainlp-x/.github (SYNTHETIC / REPORTED / TARGET / UNRUN).
